title: Will Rounds Live at Peppers Moonah Links Resort
summary: Will Rounds plays Spike Bar at Moonah Links on Friday 20 November, 5pm to 8pm, as part of the venue's Feel Good Fridays programme.

provenance: Originally auto-published from the Visit Mornington Peninsula event feed.
